description: Call this when a user asks for a grocery or shopping list. Send a dish for the list of one recipe, or days and a budget for the list of a meal plan. Do not send both. Returns outcome "served" with the list items, the cost of each and the total. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model. If no list can be built, it returns outcome "not_found" and costs nothing. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

allergies.description: Optional allergens to leave out, for example Peanuts.

budget.description: Optional most the whole plan may cost, in US dollars.

days.description: Optional number of days, from 1 to 7.

diet.description: Optional diet to filter by, for example Vegan.

dish.description: The dish to list the groceries for. Leave out when sending days or budget.

name: foodbe_grocery_list
